# xyops_webhook (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "xyops_webhook" "example" {
  title           = "Example Webhook"
  enabled         = true
  url             = "https://httpbin.org/post"
  method          = "POST"
  headers         = jsonencode([{ name = "Content-Type", value = "application/json" }])
  body            = jsonencode({ text = "alert from xyops" })
  timeout         = 30
  retries         = 0
  follow          = false
  ssl_cert_bypass = false
  max_per_day     = 0
  notes           = "Managed by Terraform"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

### Required

- `url` (String, Sensitive)

### Optional

- `body` (String, Sensitive)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import xyops_webhook.example example
```
